races.name: Betway British EBF Rosemary Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
A final chance is given to ARISAIG, who hasn't won since summer 2024 but Charlie Johnston's mare is clearly capable of winning races at this level provided things drop right. Alobayyah was progressive prior to her Haydock blip last month, so she's put forward as the main danger, while Estissa and Gilding The Lily are a couple of progressive 3-y-os who may also be involved at the business end, too.

  1. ARISAIG
  2. ALOBAYYAH
  3. ESTISSA

races.name: Princess Royal Stakes (Sponsored By Betway) (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
INIS MOR presumably failed to cope with soft ground in the Yorkshire Oaks and a return to the form she showed when placed in the French/Irish Oaks prior to that will make her tough to beat. Prizeland and Coedana are next best on form, while the unbeaten Without Prejudice looks capable of making an impact in this higher grade.

  1. INIS MOR (FR)
  2. PRIZELAND
  3. COEDANA (IRE)

races.name: Betway Rockfel Stakes (Fillies' Group 2)
races.verdict:
SPIRITED GESTURE could hardly have created a better impression on her 2 starts to date and given her pedigree and connections, she's fancied to take the step up to Group 2 company in her stride. Light of Dawn and Sugar Yes Please are already pattern-race winners and they are just a couple of potential threats.

  1. SPIRITED GESTURE
  2. LIGHT OF DAWN
  3. SUGAR YES PLEASE

races.name: Betway Joel Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
TALK OF NEW YORK has developed into a smart performer this year, beaten only 1¾ lengths by Bow Echo in the St James's Palace at Royal Ascot, and he is well worth another chance having had excuses at Goodwood last time. Colori Forever wasn't seen to best effect at Haydock on his latest outing and is feared most, ahead of the reliable Persica.

  1. TALK OF NEW YORK
  2. COLORI FOREVER
  3. PERSICA (IRE)

races.name: Betway Godolphin Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
KOKBASTAU has been improving in leaps and bounds, completing a hat-trick at Sandown last month when making light of a 14 lb higher mark and looking a pattern performer in the making. He's fancied to take this step up to Listed company in his stride. Fortitudine and Castlemont are both unbeaten from the Charlie Appleby yard and the former looks the most interesting with Buick aboard.

  1. KOKBASTAU
  2. FORTITUDINE (IRE)
  3. CASTLEMONT (IRE)

races.name: Betway Bet The Responsible Way British EBF 'Confined' Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
SOLE AMBITION had clearly learnt plenty from his debut and shaped well in a very valuable maiden at York last month. He looks the one to beat. Likely improvers Senor Blues and Howzatt may emerge as the main threats, with State Emperor and Quorum the pick of the newcomers.

  1. SOLE AMBITION
  2. SENOR BLUES
  3. HOWZATT

races.name: Betway Bet 10 Get 40 Handicap
races.verdict:
The 3-y-os make the most appeal here with GO RIMBAUD shading the vote over Runswick with both trying 9f for the first time. Waterford Castle should be in the mix again after finally shedding his maiden tag, while Joulany is potentially well handicapped on his Newbury form.

  1. GO RIMBAUD
  2. RUNSWICK (IRE)
  3. WATERFORD CASTLE (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
KALLY DES BRUYERES left his chasing debut form behind when scoring at Market Rasen in April and, having not been seen to best effect next time, he is fancied to resume winning ways. He gets the vote ahead of Onehundredneighty, who looks interesting on his chasing debut, with Turpin Gold also considered.

  1. KALLY DES BRUYERES (FR)
  2. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  3. TURPIN GOLD

races.name: Read Johnny Burke's Blog At CopyBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EL CAPITAINE lacks the benefit of a recent run but Kayley Woollacott's prolific point scorer looked one to keep firmly on side when making a seamless transition to chasing at Newbury in the spring and rates a big player here on his way to better things. Little Ledgend impressed when scoring on his chase debut here recently and is next on the list back up in trip, ahead of Turndlightsdownlow.

  1. EL CAPITAINE (IRE)
  2. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE)
  3. TURNDLIGHTSDOWNLOW (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Arc Summer Chase Series Final Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PALAMON might well have been laid out for this. Country Park's defeats the last twice shouldn't be taken to suggest the handicapper has caught up with him over fences and he's second choice ahead of Merely A Detail, Youdecide and the progressive Loki's Mischief.

  1. PALAMON (IRE)
  2. COUNTRY PARK (IRE)
  3. MERELY A DETAIL

races.name: CopyBet Fixed Brush Hurdle Series Final Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for ROAD TO WEMBLEY, who overcame a troubled passage when scoring here last month and appeals as the type to progress further in handicap company. Course winner Down To Business has likely been aimed at this contest by his shrewd handler and is feared most, whilst Devon Red and Lock Stock are also of interest in what looks a competitive heat.

  1. ROAD TO WEMBLEY
  2. DOWN TO BUSINESS
  3. DEVON RED

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A wide-margin bumper winner, ADE BOY has been given time since disappointing at Market Rasen in April, so he could yet build on the promise he had shown on his second start over hurdles. He is taken to see off the challenge of Premier Tenor, who still has potential after only 2 races for his leading yard.

  1. ADE BOY (IRE)
  2. PREMIER TENOR (FR)
  3. BLACK EDDY

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GOLD FOR ALEC ended last season on the up and has run well fresh previously. He's narrowly preferred to Secret Trix in an open-looking handicap. The Egyptian Ginge isn't fully exposed over staying trips and could go well for a yard that usually has them ready to roll at this time of year.

  1. GOLD FOR ALEC (FR)
  2. SECRET TRIX
  3. THE EGYPTIAN GINGE (IRE)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DOUGLAS DC has finished runner-up in the previous 2 renewals of this race and looks weighted to go one better. The dangers are headed by Network Rgb, Mojo Ego and Al Mootamarid, who are all closely matched on their course form this summer. Potential improver Lucky Sevens completes the shortlist.

  1. DOUGLAS DC (IRE)
  2. NETWORK RGB
  3. MOJO EGO (IRE)

races.name: EITC Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
It's hard to put much faith in a 15-race maiden, but CONDOTTI has gone close a few times this season and this could be the day Hugo Palmer's 4-y-o finally puts it all together. Falcon Nine has been threatening to come good of late, so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Sweet Kiss and Ablon a couple of 4-y-o fillies not out of things, either

  1. CONDOTTI (IRE)
  2. FALCON NINE
  3. SWEET KISS

races.name: Everton In The Community Nursery
races.verdict:
This looks a strong race for the grade but ASGAR relished the increase in trip when running out a clear-cut winner on nursery debut at Yarmouth (7f) 10 days ago and with this slight step up in trip promising to hold no fears, he could well take some stopping under a penalty. That said there are several interesting types in opposition, headed up by Thebesthasyetocome, recent C&D scorer Girl Scout and Godolphin representative Noble Prince.

  1. ASGAR (IRE)
  2. THEBESTHASYETOCOME (IRE)
  3. GIRL SCOUT

races.name: PMJ Capital EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Several interesting newcomers line up and they look the ones to concentrate on, with SIZZLING AFFAIR catching the eye on paper. Lady Phillips and New Year's Eve both have plenty of stamina in their pedigree but represent very good yards and have to be respected first time out.

  1. SIZZLING AFFAIR (IRE)
  2. LADY PHILLIPS
  3. NEW YEAR'S EVE

races.name: Ashlar Construction EBF Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby's string are in tremendous form at present and it's hard to ignore JASSAS as he attempts to regain the winning thread stepping back down in grade. The other previous winners in the field, Great Oak and St Helier, make most appeal of the rest.

  1. JASSAS
  2. GREAT OAK (IRE)
  3. ST HELIER

races.name: Christopher Ward Watchmaking Handicap
races.verdict:
STORM FREE is very much in the groove now, and he may well defy a 4 lb rise to land the hat-trick. Unexposed Spaceman looks interesting back on turf for the first time since his debut, while U Sure Do could offer some each-way value in an open-looking handicap.

  1. STORM FREE
  2. SPACEMAN (IRE)
  3. U SURE DO (IRE)

races.name: By Eck Its Boddingtons Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Ralph Beckett won this last year with the now-useful Sing Us A Song and he can repeat the feat with GLORY ROAD, who found the Melrose at York too competitive last month but takes a drop in class here. Asia Force has taken off since faced with more of a test of stamina and arriving on a hat-trick, he can give the selection most to do, with Glory of The Seas completing the shortlist on return/handicap debut.

  1. GLORY ROAD (GER)
  2. ASIA FORCE (IRE)
  3. GLORY OF THE SEAS

races.name: Turf Services Handicap
races.verdict:
Perhaps a return to going softer than good will prompt a return to form from VELVET WHISPER, who came good at a similar time last year. Percy Jones has posted several fine efforts in defeat this season and is second choice ahead of low-mileage 4-y-o Joanna Hiffernan.

  1. VELVET WHISPER (IRE)
  2. PERCY JONES
  3. JOANNA HIFFERNAN

races.name: Northumbrian WaterAid Handicap
races.verdict:
RUBELLITE registered her fourth win at this course earlier this month and hasn't been harshly treated by the handicapper for that success. She can follow up. Farabove The Limit and Havachoc can also make their presence felt.

  1. RUBELLITE (IRE)
  2. FARABOVE THE LIMIT (IRE)
  3. HAVACHOC

races.name: Esh Stantec Handicap
races.verdict:
RUGBY UNION did well under the circumstances having had his run blocked more than once when scoring over C&D 23 days ago and a 3 lb rise for that breakthrough success ought to see him very competitive again. Balmoral Boy arrives on the back of a good third at Redcar and is feared up in trip, with Token Love another fancied to be in the shake-up.

  1. RUGBY UNION (USA)
  2. BALMORAL BOY (IRE)
  3. TOKEN LOVE (FR)

races.name: MMB Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ONE OF THE BOYS had been going the right way prior to a poor effort on turf last month and can get back on track here. The consistent Brash may prove most troublesome.

  1. ONE OF THE BOYS (IRE)
  2. BRASH (IRE)
  3. ELITE APPROACH

races.name: United Infrastructure EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DREAMED came in for support but was too green at the business end to get the job done on debut and can make amends at the second time of asking. Arenite should be on the premises again, with Top Cote entitled to come on for his recent outing. Alberich and Lion's Den appeal most of the newcomers.

  1. DREAMED
  2. ARENITE
  3. TOP COTE (IRE)

races.name: Selwood Handicap
races.verdict:
This could be a good chance for INVINCIBLE CROWN to land a second C&D success inside a week. Khabib was a respectable fourth to the selection here last Saturday and can get a bit closer on the revised terms. Sixcor is next on the list.

  1. INVINCIBLE CROWN (IRE)
  2. KHABIB (IRE)
  3. SIXCOR

races.name: MWH Treatment Handicap
races.verdict:
BAJAN BANDIT bounced back from a rare poor effort to win over C&D 6 days ago and looks well capable of following up given he escapes a penalty for that success. Four-time C&D winner Barleybrown chased the selection home that day and could face the same scenario here, while, Volenti is well weighted if able to race more efficiently.

  1. BAJAN BANDIT
  2. BARLEYBROWN
  3. VOLENTI (IRE)

races.name: Today's Wonderful Sponsors Handicap
races.verdict:
FLOWSTATE has won his last 3 outings here and clearly saves his best for this track so will strip a lot fitter for his recent return at Southwell when going without his usual visor. He's taken to prove too strong for recent winner Beattie Is Back and the class-dropping Frankies Dream.

  1. FLOWSTATE (IRE)
  2. BEATTIE IS BACK
  3. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Northumbrian WaterAid Sprint Handicap
races.verdict:
LORD ABAMA went close to cashing in on his much-reduced mark over C&D last week and a reproduction of that effort may well suffice. Ridgemaster and Desert Master arrive in good nick and head the opposition.

  1. LORD ABAMA (IRE)
  2. RIDGEMASTER (IRE)
  3. DESERT MASTER

races.name: Friday Night Lights At Dundalk Claiming Maiden
races.verdict:
A wide-open claiming maiden in which preference is for WILLOFTHEPEOPLE, who probably needed the run in a first-time tongue strap after 11 months off when fifth at Bellewstown recently and Ger Lyons' 3-y-o drops back down to a sprint trip. The return to 6f should suit In The Gloaming, so he's put forward as the main threat on all-weather debut, with Aughlish and Saint Acclaim taken to fight out third.

  1. WILLOFTHEPEOPLE (IRE)
  2. IN THE GLOAMING (IRE)
  3. AUGHLISH (IRE)

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Stadium Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
INITIAL BLUE continued the good work this year when making a winning stable debut at Laytown, again showing a willing attitude from the front, and he is taken to record a fifth success of the campaign. The main danger could be Caffu Zafeen, who is respected under a penalty, ahead of Soulful Diva.

  1. INITIAL BLUE (IRE)
  2. CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE)
  3. SOULFUL DIVA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SENSATIONAL FILLY is an expensive €300,000 purchase out of a sister to top-class Wonderful Tonight and looks the type that can make a positive impact on debut. Haven showed improvement when runner-up at Cork 16 days ago and is open to further progress on her all-weather bow, making her the main threat, while Battle Tested is another well-bought debutante who commands respect.

  1. SENSATIONAL FILLY (FR)
  2. HAVEN (IRE)
  3. BATTLE TESTED (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
STORM ERIC bounced back to form when second over C&D last week and while his strike rate is underwhelming, he may well improve it slightly here. Leannespour was better than the result in that aforementioned race and can finish closer this time, with Dubai Opulence also of interest.

  1. STORM ERIC (IRE)
  2. LEANNESPOUR (IRE)
  3. DUBAI OPULENCE (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Diamond Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
MILITARY ORDER has been off since running at Bahrain last year but is strictly the one to beat on form. Geryon has had a reliable year on the whole and looks the biggest danger to the selection, while Charles Fort can fill out the places.

  1. MILITARY ORDER (IRE)
  2. GERYON (IRE)
  3. CHARLES FORT

races.name: Bookings Open For Christmas Parties At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
SLIEVE BINNIAN is well worth another chance back in much calmer waters off a reduced mark. The 3-y-os may offer most resistance, notably Hamiyan and Camino Lad.

  1. SLIEVE BINNIAN (IRE)
  2. HAMIYAN (FR)
  3. CAMINO LAD (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate Your Special Occasion At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
The addition of Colin Keane could be the catalyst for VERVAIN to double her career tally. The dangers are headed by 3-y-o pair Connecteo and Connova. In-form pair Deluca Chop and Bhean Saibhre are also respected, while My Vonnie is one to consider at bigger prices in a competitive big-field handicap.

  1. VERVAIN (IRE)
  2. CONNECTEO (IRE)
  3. CONNOVA (IRE)

races.name: John J. Galvin Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
A useful stayer on the Flat for Willie Mullins, REACHING HIGH should be able to make it second time lucky over hurdles. The dangers are headed by Ladbroke Grove and Confidence Within, who bring positive profiles from bumpers. Henry De Bromhead's Midtown Manhattan is another to note if lining up.

  1. REACHING HIGH (IRE)
  2. LADBROKE GROVE (FR)
  3. CONFIDENCE WITHIN (IRE)

races.name: MCG Ladies Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WHO'S DA GOOSE made a successful handicap debut at Wexford last month and with the scope to rate higher, he can follow-up for last year's winning jockey and trainer partnership. Tell Me See and Freddie Robdal head the opposition.

  1. WHO'S DA GOOSE
  2. TELL ME SEE (IRE)
  3. FREDDIE ROBDAL (IRE)

races.name: Trant Goodwill Stakes Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
A few to consider but KELLY'S COSMOS is on a tempting mark on last season's form and is from a yard that won this last year, so he could be worth chancing. Surviving Murmansk would have gone very close had he not been badly hampered at Bellewstown so is second choice ahead of progressive pair Euro Maker and Loi des Jeux.

  1. KELLY'S COSMOS (IRE)
  2. SURVIVING MURMANSK (IRE)
  3. EURO MAKER (IRE)

races.name: Ballymore Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
VENUSIENNE has been hiked up the handicap for her Galway victory but she was far from fully extended and remains with potential. She is taken to score again. Paul's Dream, Cosmos D'Ainay and Autumn Twist make up the shortlist.

  1. VENUSIENNE (FR)
  2. PAUL'S DREAM (IRE)
  3. COSMOS D'AINAY (FR)

races.name: Guinness Listowel Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
RUN FOR THE BORDER got back on track when runner-up in a stronger contest at Ballinrobe a fortnight ago and remains fairly treated. She makes fair appeal. Moonshine Girl and Strong Contender head the list of dangers.

  1. RUN FOR THE BORDER (IRE)
  2. MOONSHINE GIRL (IRE)
  3. STRONG CONTENDER (IRE)

races.name: Paud, Sarah & Mary Fitzmaurice Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GAELIC DES CHASTYS was shaping up well prior to unseating on reappearance and could be poised to repeat his victory in this corresponding event 12 months ago. Cloonainra looks interesting returning to this track/fences and may prove the main danger ahead of Stoneyford Lady.

  1. GAELIC DES CHASTYS (FR)
  2. CLOONAINRA (IRE)
  3. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE)

races.name: Shanahan Power Irish EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
VIVA LAA VIDA showed promise in a bumper that's worked out well at Down Royal in March and is fancied to strike at the second time of asking for a yard going well with its runners in this discipline. Shuil Solas is worth another chance to build on a promising debut having shaped as if amiss at Wexford last time, while Orbital Ocean is an appealing newcomer to monitor closely in the betting.

  1. VIVA LAA VIDA (IRE)
  2. SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
  3. ORBITAL OCEAN (IRE)

races.name: Listowel Races Supporters Club Failte Abhaile (Q.R.) Race In Memory Of Pat Scanlon
races.verdict:
DAVY CROCKETT didn't go on as expected over hurdles (also fell sole chase start) but got his career back on track with the help of the stewards when making a successful debut in this sphere at Tramore 6 weeks ago. Promising to be suited by this longer trip and open to improvement, he edges preference over Joseph O'Brien's Delta, who is more than capable but has become frustrating. Sunny South West and Quinta Do Lago complete the shortlist.

  1. DAVY CROCKETT (IRE)
  2. DELTA
  3. SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)

races.name: Prix De La Cote Bleue Handicap
Prix Des Trois Roses D'argent Stakes
Gd Px Dynavena - Gd Px Des Vendanges - Attele
Prix De L'amicale Midi Pyrenees Auvergne - Attele
Grand Prix De L'u.e.t. (gr A) - Attele
Grand Prix De L'u.e.t. (gr B) - Attele
Prix De La Societe Du Trotteur Francais - Monte
